# ppds_plugins_list

List registered plugin assemblies in the Dataverse environment. Shows plugin types and their registered steps (message/entity/stage combinations). By default excludes hidden system assemblies and Microsoft.* assemblies.

## Input schema

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| nameFilter | `String` | no | Filter by assembly name (partial match) |
| includeHidden | `Boolean` | no | Include hidden system steps (default false) |
| includeMicrosoft | `Boolean` | no | Include Microsoft assemblies (default false) |
| maxRows | `Int32` | no | Maximum assemblies to return (default 50, max 200) |

## Output

Returns `Task<PluginsListResult>`.
